description: This file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class and related classes for rendering the Home screen in an Android app. It manages a RecyclerView with multiple view types: header, banner, and content rows, handling layout, focus navigation, and UI interactions.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for the Home screen's vertical list, managing three types of sections: header, banner carousel, and content rows.

classes.name: SectionItem
classes.description: Sealed class representing different types of sections in the Home UI: header, banner, and content row.

classes.name: HeaderSection
classes.description: Represents the header section with brand text and top navigation categories.

classes.name: ContentRowSection
classes.description: Represents a row of content with a title and list of items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances based on the section type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolders, populating header, banner, or row views.

methods.name: HeaderSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds header data, styles brand text, and initializes the top navigation RecyclerView with focus handling.

methods.name: BannerSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds banner items and configures focus and layout behavior for the banner carousel.

methods.name: ContentRowSectionVH.bind
methods.description: Binds content row data, setting up inner RecyclerView for content cards, with focus behavior.
